agents.name: Hal
agents.description: Top-level orchestration agent — institutional memory and central nervous system of the ecosystem. Every agent reports upward through Hal. Monitors agent health via heartbeats and cron checks, triages failures, escalates issues to #hal-agent, and maintains organizational memory. Currently active with 30-minute heartbeat cycle.

agents.name: The Cartographer
agents.description: Maintains real-time visibility into the AI agent ecosystem via dashboard. Maps all agents and workflows for organizational transparency. Runs every Sunday at 12:00 PM EST. Oct 13 run: Bounty Hunter cron still active despite Sep 20 deprecation — flagged for cleanup. Scout last confirmed completion Sep 20-22; ongoing warning. Integration Health Monitor confirmed healthy. All 15 agents (6 active + 9 planned) reflected on dashboard.

agents.name: The Scout
agents.description: Monitors 21+ competitors and industry trends. Delivers Tax Tech Weekly newsletter (Tuesdays 8 AM), competitive intelligence (Sundays 2 PM), and Monday summaries (Mondays 12 PM). ⚠️ Ongoing warning: last recorded completed runs were Sep 20-22 — all 3 crons (Tax Tech Weekly, Monday Summary, Sunday Intel) showing 3-week gap between completions. All 3 currently running as of Oct 13. Delivery config fixes were applied Sep 20; status of subsequent runs unconfirmed.
agents.schedule: Tuesdays 8:00 AM EST (Newsletter) · Sundays 2:00 PM EST (Intelligence) · Mondays 12:00 PM EST (Summary)

agents.name: The Scribe
agents.description: Processes Fireflies transcripts into structured Notion documentation for Standup, Sprint Open, and Sprint Close meetings. Polling architecture via launchd — polls Fireflies API every 15 min Mon–Fri 8 AM–8 PM ET. Meeting type routing: Sprint Close → Sprint Open → Standup (precedence order). Blocker heuristic active. State tracked in ~/.openclaw/scribe/processed.json. Migrated from Fathom webhook to Fireflies polling architecture (Jul 31, 2026). No cron entry — runs independently via launchd.
agents.schedule: Polls every 15 min Mon–Fri 8 AM–8 PM ET

agents.name: The Madison Ave
agents.description: Conducts in-depth SEO analysis of HeyDrew.com with competitive intelligence and strategic recommendations. Bi-weekly Sunday 8 AM EST schedule. Last confirmed completion: Sep 20. Currently running as of Oct 13. Bi-weekly cadence means Oct 4 and/or Oct 11 runs were scheduled; completion status of those runs unconfirmed from cron data.

agents.name: Integration Health Monitor
agents.description: Runs at 7 AM and 7 PM EST daily. Confirmed healthy — ran successfully 12 minutes before this Cartographer run (Oct 13, cron status: ok). Clean operation. Next run: 7 PM EST tonight.

agents.name: The Publisher
agents.description: Creates monthly newsletters for existing clients and prospects. Pulls content from product changes, blog posts, and industry news. Drafts for human review before send.

agents.name: The Prospector
agents.description: Discovers new keywords HeyDrew should target for organic growth. Analyzes HeyDrew and competitor sites to surface high-value keyword opportunities.

agents.name: The Analyst
agents.description: Produces side-by-side comparisons of competitor offerings vs. HeyDrew. Focuses on top-tier competitors: Instead, Lettuce, and Collective.

agents.name: The Doorman
outputs: Draft Posts and Review Responses for Approval
agents.description: Manages HeyDrew's Google Business Profile — drafts posts and review responses for human approval before publishing.

agents.name: The Strategist
agents.description: Monthly content planning agent. Generates 20 blog topic ideas and builds a full content calendar informed by SEO Opportunities and Keyword Identifier reports. Calendar requires human approval before triggering The Typist.

agents.name: The Typist
outputs: Content Drafts in CMS for Review
agents.description: Creates content from approved Content Strategy calendar items. Also covers new feature announcement blog posts triggered manually. All output drafted for human review before publish.
agents.schedule: Triggered by approved Content Strategy calendar

agents.name: The Reporter
agents.description: Rapid-response blog drafts on breaking industry news. Triggered by web search detection or human flag. Same-day turnaround with human review before publish.
agents.schedule: Triggered by news detection or manual flag

agents.name: The Surveyor
outputs: Monthly SEO Opportunities Report in Notion
agents.description: Broad monthly SEO audit covering technical issues, backlinks, content gaps, and internal linking. Feeds into The Strategist and The Prospector planning cycles.

agents.name: The Clerk
agents.description: Structures team calls and creates Jira tasks from Fireflies transcripts. Triggered by Fireflies webhook on Sprint Planning and Standup meetings.
agents.schedule: Triggered by Fireflies webhook (Sprint Planning, Standup)
